review.notes: All 21 PDF pages word-compared with the OCR markdown; code fence balanced, 11 figure embeds present. Defects found: the two framework footnote bodies on p.11 were dropped while the inline $^{1}$/$^{2}$ markers survive (URLs verified on 300 dpi render); OCR misread the printed (sic) source typo "Accruacy" as "Accrualy" and the Table 7 stage label "Mulit-Image" as "Multit-Image" (both verified on renders; the PDF itself prints these spellings, including in body text on p.6 which prints "Multi-Image" correctly, so only Table 7 keeps the printed typo). The running header "Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B" on every content page and the arXiv side stamp are page furniture omitted by the OCR; benchmark names like MMMU(Val) dropped from pages 3, 12-14 exist only inside vector chart images already embedded as figures; "S2" tokens are LaTeX subscript notation variance.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.11 prints "Accruacy results are presented for our model and compared to several current, open-weight non-thinking and thinking models in Tables 5 and 6" (visually verified at 300 dpi). The source's own typo is "Accruacy"; the OCR additionally misread it as "Accrualy". Restores the printed spelling.

patches.before: Stage 3: Long Context, Multit-Image, and RAI
patches.after: Stage 3: Long Context, Mulit-Image, and RAI
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.21 Table 7 row label prints "Stage 3: Long Context, Mulit-Image, and RAI" (visually verified at 300 dpi; the source typo "Mulit" is printed only here, body text on p.6 prints "Multi-Image"). The OCR misread it as "Multit-Image".

Physical p.11 footnote block prints "1https://github.com/microsoft/eureka-ml-insights" and "2https://github.com/open-compass/VLMEvalKit" (visually verified at 300 dpi). The OCR kept the inline markers in "Eureka ML Insights $^{1}$ and VLMEvalKit $^{2}$" but dropped both footnote bodies; restored after the carrying paragraph.
